C1020.title: Figurine Pornography Case: 12 Convicted, Industry Rocked
C1020.summary: In April 2025, the Baoshan District People's Court in Shanghai issued a first-instance verdict against 12 defendants for producing and selling "cast-off" figurines, convicted of manufacturing and distributing obscene materials for profit.
